Retain only a149word side carryover describing the still-announced treasury plan, updated own-card price context and separate equity-versus-token risks. The June30 placement and chair headlines remain explicitly earlier announcements.

The July3 Stocktwits financing-and-skepticism story is the same story cited July4. The152word side now labels it a carryover, adds no operating milestone and keeps funding/execution risk as its purpose. A new share price is not presented as a new catalyst.

The planned Pentagon stake and magnet-plant support are the same July10 stories already available to the July11 edition. The shortened 157-word side explicitly calls this a policy-financing carryover, supplies no new operating result and retains updated own-card context with execution, dilution and valuation risks. Government support is not presented as a completed earnings stream.

The repeated crypto-family presence does not imply the same audience or investment claim. This Bitcoin side adds freshJuly14 Reuters institutional-demand coverage and The Block reporting of Wintermute distinguishing institutional BTC/ETH activity from retail memecoin interest. The participation split is the selection reason, rather than a further price rise. The text keeps ETFs, treasury equities and memecoins distinct and does not claim a measured retail ranking.

The crypto-family frequency diagnostic spans distinct assets and developments. This side item has concrete July15 evidence: Standard Chartered launching institutional Bitcoin/Ether spot trading and SharpLink reporting its Ether-holdings milestone. Those access and balance-sheet developments support a separate selection after the earlier Bitcoin-policy/breakout and treasury-equity narratives. Keep the distinction between token exposure and the funding premium of a treasury share.

Retain the XRP side for its own concrete July17 peak/regulatory-advance headline and July16 Ripple-Ctrl Alt tokenization agreement. This differs from Bitcoin ETF/legislation attention and Ether institutional-access/treasury mechanics elsewhere in the trailing sequence. The prose keeps token-holder returns separate from infrastructure adoption and supplies a reversal/liquidity risk, with no reserved crypto slot or measured popularity claim.

The Marina expansion and Stocktwits retail-attention story were already used July16. Retain the147word side as an explicitly named capacity-expansion carryover with updated completed-close context and execution/funding risk, without suggesting a new commercial milestone.

After July18 initial retail-resurrection coverage and July21 weekly frenzy/sponsorship, the July22 lead addresses fresh July21 reporting of Eric Jackson saying the shares are worth40dollars and explicit Reddit meme framing. It studies the new price-target anchor and participation mechanism while calling the target an investor opinion, not guidance or a promised outcome. These newly cited July21 stories postdate the previous July21 midnight cutoff; higher share prices alone are not the claimed update.
